Container.Name: sure-itemizer
Container.Overview:
Splits and renames merchant transactions in Sure (we-promise/sure) using the merchant's own order data, so Sure's AI categorizer sees what was actually bought instead of just the store name.
Amazon, Target and eBay: each charge is split into the items it paid for, with tax and shipping spread by price. Venmo: payments from your bank are renamed ("Venmo to Alex: pizza"), and cash-outs are split into the payments behind them.
Starts in DRY RUN: the status page shows what it would change, and nothing is written to Sure until you set DRY_RUN=false. Splits need Sure v0.7.6 or newer; renames work on any version.
Choose merchants with Sources, then connect each one from the status page (Integrations, Connect). Amazon, Target and Venmo passwords are used once to sign in and never stored; eBay uses your own free eBay developer keys. Step-by-step guides are in the README. Set an Apprise URL to be told when a merchant needs you to sign in again or a run fails.

Config.Name: Status page
Config.Description: Status page and Run now button

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: State database and saved merchant sign-ins

Config.Name: Sure API key
Config.Description: Sure → Settings → API keys, read_write scope

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = only show planned splits; false = write them to Sure

Config.Name: Apprise URL
Config.Description: Optional. Where to send notifications (a merchant needs you to sign in again, a run failed), as Apprise URLs: e.g. discord://webhook_id/webhook_token or ntfys://topic. Several can be separated by commas. Formats: https://github.com/caronc/apprise/wiki

Config.Name: Status page URL
Config.Description: Optional. Where you open this page, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8686; used as the link in notifications.

Config.Name: Run times
Config.Description: Comma-separated local times to run daily

Config.Name: Lookback days
Config.Description: How far back to look for unprocessed transactions

Config.Name: Sources
Config.Description: Comma-separated merchant sources: amazon, target, venmo, ebay
